sn_aia_tool.description: Use this tool when a client uploads or attaches a document in chat. Validates file format and legibility, queries institutional knowledge base policies (KB0010263 for Sales Agreements / KB0010264 for Proof of Insurance) to verify correctness and completeness (17-character VIN, pricing math, liability minimums, loss payee clauses), and automatically extracts verified particulars directly into the description field of the financial task.
sn_aia_tool.input_schema: [{"name":"task_sys_id","description":"The sys_id of the target financial task","mandatory":false},{"name":"task_number","description":"The number of the target task (e.g. LTB0001001)","mandatory":false},{"name":"file_name","description":"The filename of the uploaded file (e.g. sales_agreement.pdf)","mandatory":true},{"name":"document_type","description":"Category: 'sales_agreement' or 'proof_of_insurance'","mandatory":false},{"name":"extracted_text","description":"Text content or OCR transcription of the uploaded file","mandatory":false}]
sn_aia_tool.name: validate_and_extract_document_data
